description: This file defines the interface for a socket adaptor class that manages Unix domain socket connections, including methods for connecting, listening, reading, writing, and managing active connections. It also includes logging macros and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: socket_adaptor
classes.description: A class managing Unix domain socket communication, supporting connection, listening, data transfer, and callback registration.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Connects to a Unix domain socket at the specified path.

methods.name: start_listening
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming Unix domain socket connections at the specified path.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Writes data buffer to the socket.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Fetches all available data from the socket into internal buffer.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Provides previously fetched data into an external vector.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Provides previously fetched data into a user buffer, returning number of bytes.

methods.name: get_active_connections
methods.description: Returns the number of active socket connections.

methods.name: register_data_ready_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when data is ready.
